A bird followed by hundreds of birds. I pass through the hundred-fold bird, without disturbance. The birds are seething.
I move myself. I move a rock. The birds enter the rock, leave the rock. I move the rock against the direction of bird, while they watch
I see a function f I do not understand. In theory, I follow the rhythms of minari standing still as exception. A lump of rhythms in the shape of minari
Rhythm outside rhythm Rhythm is no abode Rhythm is most of me blended into it, therefore
I break into today’s minari and try to repair minari, but a machine only wants a larger machine to smash itself, rather than become the machine itself. Minari leaps into the minari family
And smells foul on occasion. Into the hollow leaf Fly the great bundles of minari
I wake minari. In the mechanical arrangement, most minari are nothing beyond minari
I have your fire. Frozen fire, I blow on it softly. You do not realize fire. The evening darkens, I walk underground embracing the city’s return. I pulled away the foot lodged in my heart, waiting for wider swarms of straw
I knock down the sky. I follow the sky. Just remember to be kind to the black stove that had crouched and to the scale that shot up pell-mell and sprouted today
I watch the hardened sun enter the bricks. As though I were the final weather, I put off the sunset and abandon the sunset.
